Papa John's International is a publicly traded company with no single controlling majority owner. At the corporate stock level, the largest shareholders are institutional investors: BlackRock Advisors LLC holds approximately 15.37% and Vanguard Fiduciary Trust Co. holds approximately 11.79% of shares [d4]. Among individual shareholders, founder John H. Schnatter remains the largest individual owner with approximately 17.83% of the company (5.82 million shares), though his stake has declined significantly from earlier levels — by March 2020 it had fallen below 5% before apparently recovering [d5][d9]. At the franchise ownership level, Bajco Group is the largest privately held franchisee, operating 206+ Papa Johns restaurants across 11 U.S. states [d6], while individual franchisee Nadeem Bajwa also owns 192 Papa Johns stores [d8]. Overall, institutional shareholders collectively dominate corporate ownership, with BlackRock and Vanguard as the top institutional holders [d2][d4].
